facts.fact: Archie 坚持送 Kiamling（他先叫错成 Miss Kim）回家，Hoi 却莫名其妙跟在她另一侧、勉强与他并行。
facts.anchor: Archie insisted on walking Miss Kim, no, Kiamling, home, but for some reason that Hoi fellow loped along on the other side of her, trying to keep pace.

facts.fact: Hoi 说头几天 Jingling 一直和他两个人一起守夜，话里带刺，Archie 感到他狠狠瞪过来的目光。
facts.anchor: “She came the first few days to keep watch with me. Just the two of us.” The remark was pointed, and Archie felt the full blaze of Hoi’s glare.

facts.fact: Hoi 改用粤语冲 Kiamling（唤她 Ah Kiam）发难，讥讽英国人竟站在道德高地，还拿孟加拉大饥荒来反刺。
facts.anchor: “Do you hear that, Ah Kiam? An Englishman on the moral high ground. I didn’t think I would see the day. Perhaps the Great Bengal Famine was just an exaggeration.”

facts.fact: Archie 反唇相讥，说自己可不是那个满仓库赃物的人——直指 Hoi，等于把底牌摊开。
facts.anchor: “I’m not the one with a warehouse full of stolen goods.” Archie threw down his ace.

facts.fact: Hoi 先转身回到 Kiamling 身边，结巴承认是为了弥补瓷器损失才这么干，说这只是最快最省事的权宜之计，话没说完借口就崩了。
facts.anchor: Hoi gor went back towards her first. “I… I needed to recoup the loss of the porcelain. It was the quickest, easiest way. It’s not a long-term thing. I don’t…” His excuses cracked.

facts.fact: Kiamling 打断两个男人的争吵，说自己不知道也不在乎她在异界时发生了什么，只想躺下来歇一个星期，别再听两只嗡嗡叫的蚊子。
facts.anchor: “I don’t know what happened when I was in there, and I do not care! I just want to lie down for a week. Not listen to a couple of whining mosquitoes.”

facts.fact: Archie 递上胳膊，本以为会挨一记冷眼，Kiamling 却感激地靠住他；她比他以为的更累，两人对 Hoi 的敌意立刻散去，送她回家成了最要紧的事。
facts.anchor: He expected a withering look, but instead she leant against him gratefully. She was more exhausted than she was letting on. The animosity with Hoi dissipated at once; getting her home was the priority.

facts.fact: 他做的饭一端上，Kiamling 就吃光自己那份，见他不拦，又把锅里剩下的也扫净，还塞着满嘴问他从哪儿学来做「foo yung」。
facts.anchor: Kiamling devoured her portion, and then, when he did not protest, the leftovers in the pan also. “Where did you learn to make foo yung?” she asked through a stuffed mouthful.

facts.fact: Kiamling 拉下宽松上衣一侧查看肩膀，颈背露出一片渗血化脓的虫咬；Archie 撞见，话卡在喉咙里。
facts.anchor: Kiamling pulled down one side of her loose top to examine her shoulders. A rash of insect bites ran down her neck and back, weeping bloody sores.

facts.fact: 她说自己没事，Archie 回她一个人够不着后背；Kiamling 脱口「Jingling 会……」，可妹妹并不在——姐妹之间出了事，她连名字都说不下去。
facts.anchor: “I’m fine.” “You won’t be able to reach by yourself.” “Jingling will…” Kiamling started. But her sister was not here.

facts.fact: Kiamling 哑声承认那道旧疤是一个靠得太近的 geongsi 留下的、自己当时太莽撞；Archie 带笑反问「当时？」，指的是她刚连穿九道墙。
facts.anchor: Her voice was thick when she finally responded. “A geongsi who got too close. I was reckless.” “Was?” His voice rang with amusement. She had just run through a series of walls nine times.

facts.fact: Kiamling 说自己一辈子只想护住妹妹、给她最好的，结果发现 Jingling 一直在香港酒店和娱乐区唱歌，还想闯出个名堂。
facts.anchor: “All I ever wanted to do was keep my sister safe. Protected. I wanted what was best for her. Only to find out she’s been singing at the Hongkong Hotel and in the entertainment district.

facts.fact: Archie 说自己没告别就离开英国、当时太愤怒，母亲一直把这件事称作背叛；时间与距离让他反省。
facts.anchor: “I left England without saying goodbye. I was so angry. My mother kept calling it a betrayal. Time and distance have made me reflect.

facts.fact: 他直视 Kiamling，劝她别对自己的妹妹犯同样的错；随即意识到她的脸离自己非常近。
facts.anchor: His eyes locked on hers. “Don’t make the same mistake with your sister.” He was aware suddenly of how close her face was.

facts.fact: 他俯身要吻她时，胸前的十字架滑出衣领荡向 Kiamling，她用两根手指捏住，嘴角带着笑。
facts.anchor: It was his crucifix, come free of his shirt and swinging towards Kiamling as he lowered his lips to hers. She stopped it with a finger and thumb, a coy smile playing on her lips.

facts.fact: Archie 像被烫到一样弹开，把十字架攥在那只受伤的手下，金属冷得像冰。
facts.anchor: Archie flew back like he had been scalded. He clutched the cross under his injured hand. The metal was ice cold.

facts.fact: 他转而伸手去摸口袋里母亲给他的银豆护身符，却在碰到之前收住，结果两手空空。
facts.anchor: He found himself reaching for the silver bean in his pocket instead; the keepsake his mother had given him. He caught himself before he touched it, still empty-handed.

facts.fact: 门外公鸡报晓，破晓的红紫色染上薄云底；门在 Archie 身后砰地关上，他没有回头。
facts.anchor: Outside, the cockerel crowed as the pre-dawn red and purple lit the underbelly of the thin clouds. The door banged in Archie’s wake, but he did not look back.
